responsibilities: Manage full-cycle recruitment for CDL drivers across multiple lanes and terminals.
Source candidates via trucking job boards, cold calling, SMS outreach, and database mining.
Assist in developing recruitment marketing strategies and manage driver referral programs.
Pitch the company's value proposition to prospective drivers.
Build positive, trust-based relationships with candidates through phone, email, and in-person communication.
Review applications, employment histories, and CDL verifications.
Submit background checks and manage applicant tracking via J. J. Keller.
Coordinate drug screens, DOT physicals, and road tests with safety and compliance teams.
Guide new hires through onboarding, communicate offer details and start-date logistics, and process new-hire paperwork.
Maintain relationships with drivers post-hire to support welfare, engagement, and retention.
Track requisitions, recruiting metrics, and pipeline data.
Monitor competitor postings and market pay rates across multiple US states.
requirements: 3–5 years in high-volume driver recruiting, safety & training, or fleet operations within the transportation industry.
Experience hiring drivers across multiple US states is highly preferred.
Strong familiarity with HOS (Hours of Service), DOT regulations, driver welfare practices, and industry compliance tools.
Strong phone sales skills and ability to engage candidates confidently.
Excellent relationship-building and interpersonal abilities, both verbal and written.
High attention to detail and personal integrity when handling sensitive compliance and safety screening.
Self-motivated with strong organizational and time-management skills.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
Hands-on experience with modern Applicant Tracking Systems and driver qualification software, preferably J. J. Keller.
Strong familiarity with automated outreach and digital recruitment marketing tools.
